sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Vanthorle. Vanthorle is a desktop Markdown editor built with Tauri 2, a Rust backend and a Svelte 5 front end. Install with `pnpm install`, then run `pnpm tauri dev` to open the app with hot reload. The Rust code lives in `src-tauri/`, and the editor UI in `src/lib/editor/`. Run front-end tests with `pnpm vitest` and Rust tests with `cargo test` inside `src-tauri/`. Files are saved with an atomic write: write to a temp file, then rename.

Rules. Autosave fires 2 seconds after the last keystroke; do not lower that delay without an issue. Open documents larger than 5 MB in read-only mode. Every Tauri command exposed to the front end must be listed in `src-tauri/capabilities/default.json`. Keyboard shortcuts are defined only in `src/lib/keymap.ts`. Spell check uses the operating system's checker; never bundle dictionary files in the app. Release notes go in `CHANGELOG.md` under the next version heading.

claims.text: Vanthorle autosave fires 2 seconds after the last keystroke.
Vanthorle saves files with an atomic write.
Vanthorle opens documents larger than 5 MB in read-only mode.
Vanthorle keyboard shortcuts may be defined in any front-end file.
The Vanthorle front end is built with Svelte 5.
Vanthorle Rust tests run with cargo test inside src-tauri/.
